response.original_title: Tina Turner - Private Dancer SDE Exclusive
response.overview: Tina Turner’s classic 1984 album Private Dancer is to be released as this SDE exclusive blu-ray featuring a new Dolby Atmos Mix alongside a generous selection of additional content.  Private Dancer was Tina’s fifth solo studio album but marked her triumphant comeback in the 1980s. It includes the hit singles ‘Let’s Stay Together’, ‘What’s Love Got to Do With It’, ‘Better Be Good To Me’, ‘Private Dancer’ and ‘Show Some Respect’ and peaked at No 2 in the UK Albums Chart and No 3 on the Billboard 200.  The audio streams of Private Dancer on the SDE-exclusive blu-ray are as follows:  Private Dancer 2026 Dolby Atmos mix (48/24)  Private Dancer 2026 5.1 mix (96/24)  Private Dancer 2026 Stereo mix (96/24)  Private Dancer 2026 Instrumental Dolby Atmos mix (48/24)  Private Dancer 2026 Instrumental 5.1 mix (96/24)  Private Dancer 2026 Instrumental Stereo mix (96/24)  Private Dancer 1984 Stereo Mix (2015 Remaster) (96/24)
